selection_basis: The final SEDAR 98 report, publicly disseminated in October 2026, is the latest detailed assessment found for the Gulf management unit and uses data through 2023. It covers a three-region model, fishery catch, age/length-composition and survey inputs, fixed age-based biology, and annual population output tables. The Gulf of Mexico Fishery Management Council SSC had not yet certified the assessment for advice at the time of review; retain that status explicitly and do not label it as applied. No run-matched native Stock Synthesis files were located in the reviewed public sources. The regions remain one stock unit.
